verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a standalone command-line program and Haskell library that runs entirely on the user's own machines. It is installable via Homebrew, Chocolatey or the pandoc/latex Docker image, and can be compiled into a completely self-contained binary. It also has a documented pandoc-server HTTP mode for hosting conversions yourself, and it runs in GitHub Actions. Community users confirm local and automated use; one complaint that apt pulls in a heavy TeX Live install is friction, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of running pandoc-server in production.
